q: Name a language that compiles to JavaScript.

answers.l: Anders Hejlsberg, Microsoft, 2012. Its compiler is being ported to Go for speed.
Jeremy Ashkenas, 2009. ES6 arrow functions and classes owe it a lot.
Evan Czaplicki, 2012. No runtime exceptions in practice, and compiler errors that set a new bar.
Clojure on JavaScript, optimized by the Google Closure Compiler.
Google, 2011. Once meant to replace JavaScript in Chrome. Now it powers Flutter.
XML-like syntax that compiles to function calls.
OCaml with JavaScript-friendly syntax, from Jordan Walke, who created React.
Grew out of BuckleScript and Reason. Typed, with very fast builds.
Haskell-like, strict, and compiles to readable JavaScript.
One language, many targets: JavaScript, C++, C#, Python, Lua and more.
Kotlin’s JavaScript target.
Scala in the browser.
Type-safe and friendly, targeting both the Erlang VM and JavaScript.
Compiles to C, C++ or JavaScript.
Compiled C and C++ to asm.js before WebAssembly existed.
Facebook’s type checker. Annotations are stripped to plain JavaScript.
Google Web Toolkit, 2006. Java in, JavaScript out.
A CoffeeScript descendant. Also JavaScript’s own name for a few months in 1995.
F# to JavaScript.
Ruby to JavaScript.
Python 3 running in the browser.
Python to readable JavaScript, ahead of time.
A full-stack language with its own memoized DOM.
A modern CoffeeScript-flavored syntax for TypeScript.
OCaml to readable JavaScript. It became ReScript.
Compiles OCaml bytecode to JavaScript.
Cappuccino’s Objective-C-style superset of JavaScript. It powered 280 Slides.
CoffeeScript with await and defer, years before JavaScript had async.
Common Lisp to JavaScript.
An early ML-flavored language for JavaScript.
Dependently typed, with a JavaScript backend.
A language built just for single-page apps.
Type-safe web programming in one language.
